cd /home/jimmybones/Dokumente/OpenGym-HomeAssistant && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, time, hmac, hashlib, types, importlib.util
pkg = types.ModuleType("og"); pkg.__path__ = ["custom_components/opengym"]
sys.modules["og"] = pkg
const = types.ModuleType("og.const"); const.SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE = 300
sys.modules["og.const"] = const
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("og.security", "custom_components/opengym/security.py")
sec = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sec)

secret = "deadbeefcafe"
body = b'{"version":1,"type":"workout.finished"}'
t = int(time.time())
sig = hmac.new(secret.encode(), f"{t}.".encode()+body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
assert sec.verify_signature(secret, body, f"t={t},v1={sig}") is True
assert sec.verify_signature(secret, body, f"t={t},v1=" + "0"*64) is False
assert sec.verify_signature(secret, body, "garbage") is False
assert sec.verify_signature(secret, body, f"t={t-99999},v1={sig}") is False
print("SIGNATURE_TESTS_OK")
EOF
